description: Point de captage d'eau destinée à l’alimentation humaine en Bretagne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geobretagne.fr. Water abstraction point for human consumption in Brittany This layer is made from data from the ARS Bretagne of 2009 concerning the collection points. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Water abstraction point for human consumption in Brittany" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include eau surfacique, eau souterraine, captage, Bretagne, eau potable. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
